description: Diagnostic snapshot of the deployed MCP server plus a live probe of its store (sqlite or Postgres). Returns server name and version, protocol version, root, boot time, advertised tool names and count, a hash of the tool surface, and `store` — `{ ok, latency_ms, counts: { projects, quotes } }` from counting rows in the projects table (one row per version) and the quotes table, or `{ ok: false, latency_ms, error }`.
name: get_health
title: Health check
